userStories.title: Formalize the organ-construction/generation seam into an enforced typed ContinuityGate - no organ can bypass it
userStories.description: Every closed story so far (dialect, person/relationship model, reasoning tier, voice forge, build twin) independently followed the same convention by discipline: construct in JarvisEngine.init at the same composition point as the identity/emotion stack, feed the same IdentityContext.gatherForTurn / ContextWindowAssembler generation seam, get pinned by SystemGraphTest. That convention has held every time but is enforced by discipline, not by the compiler. This story makes it structurally impossible to build a second parallel path: a real typed ContinuityGate that every organ registers a contribution into at construction, and that IdentityContext/ContextWindowAssembler can ONLY assemble the generation payload from. No new cognitive capability - this is a structural hardening of the existing real seam, not a new brain.

userStories.title: Activate real Chatterbox TTS output with security hardening - install runtime, confirm live health, wire voice cloning safely
userStories.description: VoiceForgeAdapter/VoiceForgeBackend and voiceforge_server.py are already real and wired but chatterbox_tts is not installed so /health returns healthy:false and every reply silently falls back to platform TTS. This story closes that gap AND hardens the real security/stability gaps found in the current voiceforge_server.py: unrestricted audio_prompt_path pass-through, no auth on the local HTTP server, unpinned checkpoint revision, no input cap or inference lock.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: chatterbox_tts installed into voiceforge-env; real curl http://127.0.0.1:8765/health returns healthy:true
AC2: real end-to-end synthesis test - a real /v1/synthesize call returns real non-empty audio bytes

AC3: if the voice reference clip exists at its documented asset path, wire audioPromptPath to it and prove voice cloning activates; if absent, document as pending blocker in REPO_FACTS.md, do not fabricate
AC4: confirm setStreamingSpeak's production call path actually reaches VoiceForgeBackend and produces real audio, not the platform-TTS fallback
AC5: no changes to IdentityContext, ContextWindowAssembler, or any file touched by CONTINUITY-GATE-ENFORCED-SEAM
AC6: full regression sweep (exact stored verifyCommand) BUILD SUCCESSFUL EXIT=0

AC7 (security): /health and /v1/synthesize require a shared-secret bearer token (Authorization header) checked against a token only VoiceForgeAdapter and the local Termux caller hold - the port is reachable by any other app on this device, not exclusively JARVIS

AC8 (security): audio_prompt_path is validated against an explicit allow-listed directory (mobile/app/src/main/assets/voiceforge/) before being passed to the model - any path outside it is rejected with HTTP 400, closing the current unrestricted pass-through in _audio_path that would otherwise let a forged request voice-clone from ANY file the Termux user can read

AC9 (security): huggingface_hub.snapshot_download pins an explicit revision (commit hash) for the NAMAA-Space checkpoint instead of resolving latest, so a supply-chain change upstream can't silently swap what loads on a future fresh install

AC10 (stability): text payload length is capped (reject >2000 chars, HTTP 400) and concurrent /v1/synthesize calls are serialized through a real inference lock separate from LOAD_LOCK - prevents a malformed or overlapping request from stalling or OOMing the CPU-only synth pipeline, same failure class as prior OOM incidents
